title: Betcha By Golly, Wow
original_lyrics:
[chorus]
+
There's spark of magic in your eyes

[chorus]
+/9 +
Never thought that fairy tales came true

[bridge]
You're genie in disguise
Full of wonder and surprise. aaaaaand...

[bridge]
You're the one that I've been waiting for forever
And ever will my love for you
+ +
keep growing strong, Keep growing strong
+
If I could, I' catch falling star
To shine on you so I know where you are
+/9 +
Paint rainbow in your favorite shade
To show I love you, thinking of you
Write your name across the sky
Anything you ask, I'll try. cuuuuz...

[bridge]
You're the one that I've been waiting for forever (Don't You let ' tell You otherwise)
And ever will my love for you
+ +
keep growing strong, Keep growing strong
(falado) "Baby, sometime, man can't find words to express all the things he feels inside, but every just so often. The words of another who's truly in love seem to work out fine."
.To say I love You. I love You. To say I'm thinking of You!

[bridge]
You're the one that I've been waiting for forever
And ever will my love for you
+ +
keep growing strong, Keep growing strong
I love You baby.
